Package neqsim.process.util.mercury

Class MercuryStreamResult

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.mercury.MercuryStreamResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class MercuryStreamResult extends Object implements Serializable
Mercury in one process stream: total flow, distribution between the fluid phases and separate mercury phase.

The values are calculated from the stream fluid with MercuryPhaseEquilibrium at the temperature and pressure of the stream. A stream that holds more mercury than its gas, oil and aqueous phases dissolve carries the rest as free mercury, liquid above 234.321 K and solid below. Free mercury below 0.1 % of the mercury in the stream is not reported.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa

    • FREE_MERCURY_TOLERANCE

      private static final double FREE_MERCURY_TOLERANCE
      Fraction of the mercury in a stream below which free mercury is not reported. A stream that leaves a separator saturated with mercury shows free mercury of up to a few times 1e-4 of its mercury when it is flashed again, from the tolerance of the flash calculations.
